name: Kitsune throw
notes: Generic throw (C4), 259 shove. Clip 31 frames, hands contact 4-20 so startup 3 / active 17 / recovery 11. Deviation from C4 startup 5: -2 (the clip note says startup 4; the validator ties hit_start 4 to startup 3). Active 17 is the clip window; recovery 11 outlasts the 7-frame break window (E12). The clip carries a 28 cm hip advance that must be replaced by a data step (E15); the throw schema has no forward-travel field, so that step is NOT yet encoded (needs a schema/engine follow-up). Pushback left to fight defaults. Same buttons as Ryo's throw; Ryo's file (YOK-33) is a separate id.
